architecture_contract.warning: The paper calls the corpus scCompass-126M and says more than 120 million cells, while its stated human and mouse counts sum to 101,768,420. Preserve the discrepancy until the immutable training inventory resolves it.

required_resolution: Obtain an immutable file manifest for the object labeled Base with filename, byte size, timestamp, and SHA-256.
Inventory and hash every required tokenizer, gene median, vocabulary, and prior-knowledge payload, including Git LFS and externally hosted objects.
Bind the selected Base object to an exact training cutoff and corpus inventory.
Do not infer object identity from the portal token or the UI label Base.

embedding_contract.common_lane_rule: Freeze one layer and pooling operation before screening; no downstream label may select the layer, pooling, token length, or rank-value transformation.

input_contract.structural_missingness_rule: Do not rank structurally unassayed genes as biological zeros. Preserve assay observability and reject an input whose raw-count, Ensembl mapping, gene-median, or species contract cannot be reproduced.

prior_knowledge_contract.blocking_finding: Several checked-in prior-knowledge paths are Git LFS pointer stubs, and the repository also directs users to a mutable external folder. Pointer hashes are not payload hashes.

release.paper: GeneCompass: deciphering universal gene regulatory mechanisms with a knowledge-informed cross-species foundation model

risks: The preprocessing path loads Python pickle token, median, and prior-knowledge objects.
The model path may load a pickle-backed PyTorch or Hugging Face checkpoint from an unresolved portal object.
required_path: Obtain written terms and immutable hashes before acquisition.
Inspect pickle and checkpoint content only in a disposable no-network environment.
Convert approved plain data structures and recognized tensors to non-executable formats.
Freeze tokenizer, gene medians, prior matrices, tensor names, shapes, dtypes, and fixed-fixture numeric parity.

source_evidence: The Cell Research paper, pinned official repository, Git tree and raw source objects, and live official ScienceDB portal were checked on 2026-08-22. No checkpoint, Git LFS payload, prior-knowledge bundle, supplement, or dataset artifact was downloaded or deserialized.

task_fit.masld_adaptation: No probe, fine-tuning, LoRA, adapter, distillation, or release is admitted without written code, weight, tokenizer, and prior-knowledge terms.
task_fit.perturbation_response: not_admitted_by_the_base_checkpoint; the published GEARS-style experiment is a separately trained downstream system and requires its own exact head, splits, seeds, terms, and audit
